query:
-- المبيعات الفعلية (closed_won) مع netValue
SELECT 
  'closed_won' as type,
  COUNT(*) as count,
  SUM(CAST(value AS DECIMAL(14,2))) as total_gross,
  SUM(CAST(COALESCE(netValue, value) AS DECIMAL(14,2))) as total_net,
  SUM(CAST(COALESCE(discountValue, 0) AS DECIMAL(14,2))) as total_discount
FROM deals WHERE stage = 'closed_won' AND isDeleted = 0

UNION ALL

-- Pipeline (صفقات شغالة)
SELECT 
  'pipeline' as type,
  COUNT(*) as count,
  SUM(CAST(value AS DECIMAL(14,2))) as total_gross,
  SUM(CAST(value AS DECIMAL(14,2))) as total_net,
  SUM(CAST(COALESCE(discountValue, 0) AS DECIMAL(14,2))) as total_discount
FROM deals WHERE stage NOT IN ('closed_won', 'closed_lost') AND isDeleted = 0

UNION ALL

-- الخاسرة (closed_lost)
SELECT 
  'closed_lost' as type,
  COUNT(*) as count,
  SUM(CAST(value AS DECIMAL(14,2))) as total_gross,
  SUM(CAST(COALESCE(netValue, value) AS DECIMAL(14,2))) as total_net,
  SUM(CAST(COALESCE(discountValue, 0) AS DECIMAL(14,2))) as total_discount
FROM deals WHERE stage = 'closed_lost' AND isDeleted = 0;
